verdict.rationale: Grok can be wired into agent tooling mainly through compatibility rather than named official integrations. The REST API is OpenAI-compatible and also exposed over gRPC, and the model ships in its own coding CLI, Grok Build. It is also offered on Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry, xAI hosts a docs MCP server for AI assistants, and community users report running Grok inside Cursor. missing for 10: documented first-party integrations with named third-party coding agents or agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain-style adapters), an official SDK with dedicated docs, skills/plugins packages, and independent corroboration beyond a single Cursor anecdote.
